m.d: If you give something to someone else, you had the thing and you let the other person have it.
m.e: Give me that book, please; I want to read it.

m.d: If you give a speech, you talk to a group of people.
A girl is a female child or teenager; someone who is not a woman yet.
m.e: Many girls like to play with dolls.

m.d: A female person of any age (even a woman).
m.e: The girls are going out tonight, do you want to come?

m.d: A female animal.
m.e: My cat is a girl.

m.d: A given is something that you accept as true.
m.e: We need to make a decision about where we will live after this, but selling this house is a given.

m.d: If someone is given to doing something, they do it regularly.
m.e: My father's given to making long speeches about when he was a boy.

m.d: If someone is given to something, they wear, use, or do it often.
m.e: When she got older, she was given to elegant clothes and long speeches.

m.d: Given x means if x is true, happened, exists, etc.
m.e: Given our current problems, I don't think we can spend any more.

m.d: Given that-clause means in consideration of the fact that-clause.
m.e: Given that they are inexperienced, they've done a good job.

m.d: : This short section needs someone to add to it.
A girlfriend is a girl or young woman who is in a romantic relationship with another person.
m.e: Jeremy had been having trouble with his girlfriend.

m.d: A girlfriend can be any friend who is female.
A gift is something given to another person voluntarily.
m.e: I didn't receive many gifts this Christmas.

m.d: A special talent or natural ability.
m.e: She has a gift for singing.

m.d: A gift is given to someone as a present.
m.e: I received a gift from my parents as my Christmas present.

m.d: A giant is a very big man or woman, often in fairy tales.
m.e: Jack climbed the beanstalk and found a land ruled by a giant.

m.d: If a thing is giant, it is very big.
m.e: He bought a giant doll at the fair.

m.d: A gimme is something that is easy to get.
In golf, a gimme is a shot when the ball is very, very close to the hole.
A gig is a live performance by a musician or group playing popular or jazz music.
If a person gigs, they play at a gig.
Ginger is a strongly flavored root used in cooking.
m.e: Ginger is used to make gingerbread and ginger beer.

m.d: Ginger is a brown/red/orange color
A ginger is someone with reddish brown hair.
m.e: Many gingers have freckles.

m.d: Gin is an alcoholic drink that is made from grain or malt.
m.e: They brew their own gin.

m.d: Gil is a male given name. It is usually short for Gilbert.
Gilbert is a male given name.
Gilbert is a surname.
If a person is gifted, he or she has special abilities or talents.
Gideon is a male given name.
Gibson is a surname.
Giovanni is a male given name.
Something that, when it is described, is even bigger than the word "large". Something that is very, very large.
m.e: When it comes to canyon formations, the Grand Canyon is gigantic.

m.d: Gibberish is a language that is not understandable, because it has no meaning or is too complicated or technical.
m.e: Extraterrestrials in bad science-fiction often speak gibberish to make you understand that they are extraterrestrials.

m.d: When you giggle, you laugh softly.
m.e: Boys often laugh out loud and girls often giggle quietly.

m.d: The giraffe is the tallest land animal in the world. It is from Africa and has a very long neck.
m.e: The family went to see the giraffe in the zoo.

m.d: A gill is the breathing organ for animals that live in the sea. It helps them breathe oxygen inside of water.
m.e: If I had a gill, then I could breathe underwater.

m.d: If you gill a fish, you remove the gills from it.
If you feel giddy, you have a spinning sensation in the head causing you to have a perception of being unsteady and being about to fall.
Something that is girly is for girls, or like a girl.
m.e: "That flowery shirt is so girly!"

m.d: A gigolo is a man who is paid by a woman (often an older, wealthier woman) to be her companion or lover, or who is supported financially by a woman in…
A gingerbread is a type of cake whose main flavoring is ginger.
A flamboyant Victorian-era architectural style.
A gizmo is a vague name for any small electronic device.
A giver is someone who gives something to another person or people.
m.e: Santa Claus is a giver of gifts.

m.d: Gifford is a surname.
To gibber is to speak in a way you that cannot be understood, especially when using unknown words or known words that have no meaning put together.
m.e: This magician gibbers when he does his tricks, because he wants to appear more mysterious.
